title: Back Street Girls
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A gag manga in which three yakuza men, on their controlling boss's orders, undergo a complete makeover into women and debut as the idol group "Gokudols" (Kodansha USA blurb). Backstage they drink and gamble; on stage they are polished idols. The publisher calls it an idol gag manga "without honor" that satirizes Japan's idol industry, rated 16+.
life_message: Through black comedy it mocks image-making in the idol industry and yakuza codes of honor rather than holding up a model life.
